items.title: Google’s Pixel 11 isn’t the story; Gemini AI is
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss Google's (GOOG, GOOGL) new Pixel 11 smartphone lineup and its deeper integration of Gemini AI.

items.title: There’s a Good Chance Vanguard’s VINIX Is in Your 401(k) and You’ve Never Heard of It
items.summary: One of the biggest S&P 500 funds on the planet holds hundreds of billions in retirement savings, yet most of the people who own it have never seen its ticker and cannot buy a single share on their own.

items.title: Amazon Is the Only $3 Trillion Company That Has Never Paid a Dividend
items.summary: Four of the world's five most valuable companies send their shareholders cash every quarter. The fifth is spending more than its operations generate.

items.title: Apple Stock Rises While Norway Fund Reveals Huge Position
items.summary: Apple ranks second in the sovereign fund's global portfolio, with a disclosed holding valued at 522 billion Norwegian kroner.

items.title: Millions of Americans Own Vanguard’s VFIAX and Have No Idea What They Actually Bought
items.summary: VFIAX carries the word "diversified" in its pitch, but what sits inside the fund tells a different story about concentration, risk, and how a handful of platform giants now shape the retirement savings of millions.

items.title: Nvidia Stock Gains While Norway Fund Reveals Top Holding
items.summary: The world's largest sovereign wealth fund holds Nvidia shares worth 612 billion kroner, exceeding every other company in its portfolio.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Climbs as Norway Fund Ranks It Third
items.summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund valued its Alphabet position at 499 billion kroner, placing Google's parent above Microsoft and Amazon.

items.title: GOOGL Down 19% From 52-Week High: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Alphabet's 19% pullback reflects surging AI spending and cash-flow pressure, even as Cloud growth and a $514 billion backlog signal strong demand.
